snippet.title: Cozy Crunch | In-development Teaser Trailer | A Relaxing Indie Cat Adventure
snippet.description:
Note: this contains early footage of the game and updates have been made based on community feedback. ❤

Guide your feline friend by moving the mouse cursor — your playful fairy companion — as you frolic through a cozy, leaf-strewn forest in Cozy Crunch, a whimsical adventure where every satisfying crunch brings you closer to new rewards!

*Wishlist on Steam*
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3721660/Cozy_Crunch/

*Play the FREE demo on Itch.io*
https://jobblesackgames.itch.io/cozy-crunch

*Presskit (Dropbox)*
https://bit.ly/JobblesackGamesPresskit

*Join the Discord community*
https://discord.gg/YHVjwSwQ96


Hi! I’m Jo, a solo indie developer, and this is my first game. Cozy Crunch is inspired by the charm of classic online web games: simple, relaxing, and designed to be enjoyed in a single cozy evening. I hope it brings you a bit of calm and delight, just like it did for me while creating it.

#cozygame #indiegame #catgame #relaxinggame #steam
